The '''I-82 intel droid''' was an intelligence [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model that resembled normal-looking [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]] in appearance. Such droids could be found in large numbers at the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
